item.tib: bder gshegs rig 'dzin thugs rgyud las btags grol chen mo
item.coloph: de ltar man ngag gnad kyi gdams pa 'di/ slob dpon chen po pad ma 'byung gnas kyis/ gnas mchog phug leb rtag rtse ru/ nges med dus mtha'i sprang po bdag la rgyud (brgyud/)bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs pos rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ yi dam rig 'dzin rnams la bzod par gsol/ bka' skyongs (skyong) bstan srung rko long mi mdzad zhu/ 'di bris dge ba'i mthu dpal la brten nas/ 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob par shog dam can (dam nyams) ru tra'i sde la ma ston cig sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya/ slob dpon pad+ma thod 'phring (phreng) ni(nas/)rnal 'byor mi shig rdo rje rtsal la rgyud (brgyud) pa dge legs 'phel lo//
